from labels import label_visits

fix.code:
def label_visits(names, visits):
    """Return (lookup, lines): a name -> minutes dict and one 'name: minutes' line per visit."""
    pairs = list(zip(names, (x.minutes for x in visits)))
    lookup = dict(pairs)
    lines = ["%s: %s" % (name, value) for name, value in pairs]
    return lookup, lines
